description: Operate a BT Panel instance through its installed MCP endpoint.

fields.label: MCP Server URL
fields.description: Full MCP endpoint created by the BT Panel MCP plugin. Find it in BT Panel after installing and configuring the MCP service: https://docs.bt.cn/ai-ops/mcp/installation.

fields.label: Authorization Token
fields.placeholder: Paste your BT Panel MCP authorization token
fields.description: Bearer token copied with the MCP Server URL from BT Panel MCP Service > Security Authorization.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current BT Panel MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the tool first and obtain explicit confirmation because the server may expose command execution, firewall changes, file writes, or irreversible deletion operations.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current BT Panel MCP tool.

status.description: Whether the BT Panel tool completed successfully.

msg.description: The result or error message returned by BT Panel.

result.description: The BT Panel result object with the documented common status and message fields plus tool-specific fields.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the BT Panel MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current server-management tools, behavior annotations, and live input schemas exposed by this BT Panel MCP connection.

name.description: The exact BT Panel MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by BT Panel MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify the managed server.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform a destructive server operation.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeating the same call is expected to have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with systems outside BT Panel.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by the connected BT Panel server.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by BT Panel MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected BT Panel MCP server.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the connected BT Panel MCP server.

outputSchema.description: The current BT Panel MCP tool catalog.
